verdict.line: You lose if you all-in right after Mordekaiser pops a full Indestructible shield or drag the fight past his level 6 Realm of Death; you win if you force the mutual pull first and finish with a fully-stacked Guillotine.

brief.thesis: Neither of you has hard crowd control, so this lane is decided by who lands their pull first and whose cooldowns are up when the fight actually starts. Mordekaiser's Indestructible (W) turns him into a much tougher target for a few seconds after every trade, and your whole kit exists to punish the window right after that shield is gone or consumed. At 48.1% Darius win rate over 154 games with lane advantage rated EVEN, this is a genuine coinflip skirmish, not a lane you're supposed to lose or dominate.

theirWindow.what: Back off. His stored shield from Indestructible absorbs a big chunk of your Q/E/auto burst, so an all-in here trades badly — bait it out with a poke or wait it out (12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) instead of engaging into it.

yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Fire Apprehend (E) to hook him in, land Q (Decimate) with the blade for the heal, auto with Crippling Strike (W) for the slow, and finish with Noxian Guillotine (R) once Hemorrhage is stacked — there's no shield to eat the damage.

start.why: Run 47.9% win rate over 167 games and an 80.3% pick rate — the sustain from the potion plus Q's blade-heal keeps you ahead in the poke war before either ultimate is live.

boots.why: 49.6% win rate over 133 games, 66.2% pick — Mordekaiser's entire kit is magic damage with no hard CC to punish, so the flat magic resist outvalues Boots of Swiftness here.

core.why: Part of the 77.8% win rate path over 9 games — the active gives you the closing speed to land Apprehend before he can reposition.
Same path — stacks magic resist and move speed against a purely magic-damage matchup, which is exactly what this lane calls for.
Completes the 77.8%-win-rate order — the bleed-over-time damage reduction blunts his burst windows around Obliterate (Q) and Death's Grasp (E).

situational.when: he keeps kiting behind his Indestructible shield and you need the health and stick to close the gap
you're getting chunked hard in every trade and need the survivability more than the extra damage
you want a mobility-based gap closer instead of Youmuu's active to guarantee landing E

runes.keystoneWhy: The 54% win rate page (24.4% pick) — this is a sustained-trade matchup with no hard CC on either side, so stacking Conqueror through auto/Q/E exchanges gives you the lifesteal to outlast his Indestructible shield in extended fights. Master-tier players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery, 932 games) — better if you're playing this lane more as poke-and-kite skirmishes than committed all-ins.

summoners.why: 48.6% win rate at 36.1% pick — Ignite secures kills in an even-shape lane where neither side has a clean burst edge. Flash+Ghost is more popular (57.6% pick) but lower win rate (45.8%); Exhaust+Flash posts 72.7% but on only 5.4% pick, so treat it as a small-sample outlier rather than a default.

playing.title: Bait his W before all-in
playing.detail: Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) stores damage into a shield he can consume to heal. Engaging right after he pops it wastes your burst — poke it down or wait for it to be on cooldown first.

playing.title: Win the mutual pull
playing.detail: Your Apprehend (E, 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown, range 535) and his Death's Grasp (E, 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown, range 700) both hook. His is up more often, so don't waste yours trying to out-hook him — punish him for using his first.

playing.title: Stack 5 bleeds before Guillotine
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks, so land Q's blade (not the handle) and autos to hit 5 stacks before committing your R.

playing.title: Play safe past his level 6
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags you into his dimension and steals a portion of your stats permanently if he kills you there — don't extend trades to low HP once he hits 6.

playing.title: Re-engage off Q's heal
playing.detail: Decimate's cooldown drops to as low as 5s at max rank and heals you for hitting him with the blade — re-cast it on cooldown in extended skirmishes instead of trading once and resetting.

playing.title: Force him off single-target Q
playing.detail: Obliterate deals more damage when it only hits one target, so fight with minions between you or make him choose between hitting you and clearing wave.

playing.title: Rush your magic resist
playing.detail: He has zero hard CC to punish tenacity or armor stacking, so Mercury's Treads into Force of Nature scales your effective HP against his burst better than raw armor would.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and win rates (48.1% over 154 head-to-head games) are pulled from measured OP.GG data on the current patch; the cooldown timings, trade windows, and tactical reasoning are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being nuked by Mordekaiser’s abilities. Try to fight him when the opponent steps in your range to nuke him in one burst.
